name: Mesquite Grilled Chicken Breast with Crushed Sweet Potatoes (Let the Magic Begin)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
whyItWorks: Grilled chicken breast over mashed sweet potatoes is a high-protein, soluble-fiber powerhouse once the corn-bacon sauce is held.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the chicken breast grilled plain (light salt, no smoky mesquite rub) over the crushed sweet potatoes, holding the cream-of-corn bacon sauce and spinach.
watchOuts: Corn kernels and bacon fat in the sauce (ask to hold)
